def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    """Count words in a note, ignoring comment lines (first non-blank char is '#')."""
    total = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        total += len(line.split())
    return total
E
cat >> tests/test_wordcount.py <<'E'


def test_count_words_skips_indented_comment_lines():
    assert count_words('  \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_count_words_counts_hash_after_first_word():
    assert count_words('hello # world\n') == 3


def test_count_words_splits_on_runs_of_mixed_whitespace():
    assert count_words('a  b\t\tc \t d\ne') == 5


def test_count_words_empty_and_blank_text():
    assert count_words('') == 0
    assert count_words('  \n\t\n') == 0


def test_count_words_comment_only_and_last_line_without_newline():
    assert count_words('# a b c') == 0
    assert count_words('# x\nlast') == 1
E
